pool cleaner.name: Hayward

string trimmer.name: CRAFTSMAN

string trimmer.name: Makita
string trimmer.description: The Makita 36V (18V X2) LXT Brushless String Trimmer delivers high torque, direct-drive performance, Star Protection tech, and XPT weather-resistance, built for landscapers seeking cordless alternatives to gas models.

string trimmer.description: The Husqvarna 122C Gas String Trimmer offers a 22cc engine with Smart Start® technology, ergonomic curved shaft, 17" cutting width, and Tap'n Go line feed, perfect for homeowners needing easy-to-use, low-noise trimming.

fascia gun.name: Achedaway
fascia gun.description: The Achedaway Cupper offers dynamic cupping with app-controlled suction modes and red light therapy for faster recovery, pain relief, and skin rejuvenation. Ideal for athletes, physiotherapists, and anyone seeking customizable muscle therapy.

fascia gun.description: The Yunmai SlimChic massage gun delivers up to 3200 RPM with a compact brushless motor, three speed modes, and one-button control. Weighing just 1.5 lbs, it's perfect for convenient muscle relief at home or on the go.

coffee maker.name: Philips
coffee maker.description: The Philips 3200 Series espresso machine features LatteGo for one-touch cappuccino, espresso, and iced coffee, combining European build quality with Italian design—great for users who want simplicity and variety at home.

coffee maker.name: Nespresso

electric sander.name: Porter-Cable

electric sander.name: Milwaukee
electric sander.description: Milwaukee’s M18 Random Orbit Sander offers 7,000–12,000 OPM variable speed, REDLITHIUM™ battery tech, and up to 35 mins runtime per 3.0Ah charge. With a 5" pad and dust canister, it’s built for cordless, high-efficiency sanding.

electric sander.name: BLACKDECKER
electric sander.description: The BLACK+DECKER MOUSE® 20V MAX* cordless sander operates at 12,000 OPM, with a detail finger attachment and ergonomic two-position grip. Compact and easy to control, it’s ideal for tight spaces and DIY projects with quick-change pads and a dust bag.

electric sander.description: The RYOBI 18V ONE+ Random Orbit Sander runs at 10,000 OPM and offers 40% less vibration, delivering swirl-free finishes. With a hook-and-loop sanding pad and cordless design, it’s a reliable choice for efficient home sanding tasks.

laser measure.name: Spectra Precision
laser measure.description: The Spectra LT58G laser tool projects 3x 360° green beams with up to 25-hour battery life, auto self-leveling, and ceiling-mount accessories. Built tough for jobsite use, it’s ideal for high-precision interior layout work.

washing machine.name: Beko
washing machine.description: The Beko 7kg 1200rpm Washing Machine features a Quick 28-minute program, ProSmart Inverter motor with a 10-year warranty, LED progress indicators, and slim depth design, ideal for energy-efficient everyday laundry.

washing machine.name: Hisense
washing machine.description: The Hisense Series 7 Washer offers Auto Dosing, UV Hygiene, Auto Wash sensing, and ConnectLife smart features, combining stylish design with powerful cleaning and smart energy management.

washing machine.name: Zanussi
washing machine.description: The Zanussi Top Loader Washer features a simple 30-min daily wash, FinishIn timing function, drum positioning for easy unloading, and quick-wash options, offering efficient, user-friendly laundry care.

washing machine.name: Hotpoint
washing machine.description: The Hotpoint ActiveCare NM11 945 WC A UK N Washing Machine provides best-in-class stain removal at 20°C, Steam Hygiene, Stop&Add function, antimicrobial protection, and Rapid/Eco options for flexible washing.

washing machine.name: Haier
washing machine.description: The Haier I-Pro Series 7 Washer Dryer offers a 10kg capacity, Direct Motion Motor, I-Refresh sanitizing steam function, antibacterial treatment, and automatic weight detection for superior hygiene and fabric care.

washing machine.name: Miele
washing machine.description: Miele’s premium washers and dryers feature TwinDos automatic detergent dosing, QuickIntenseWash, heat-pump energy-saving dryers, WiFiConn@ct smart control, and endurance-tested longevity, ideal for high-performance homes.

washing machine.name: Bosch
washing machine.description: The Bosch 500 Series Front Load Washer offers a 4.5 cu. ft. capacity with advanced washing features, providing efficient and reliable laundry performance for busy households.

washing machine.name: GE
washing machine.description: The GE 5.0 cu. ft. Smart Front Load Washer features SmartDispense, UltraFresh Vent with OdorBlock, Steam Sanitize, and WiFi connectivity, designed for deep cleaning, freshness, and smart convenience.

curling iron.name: Sultra
curling iron.description: The Sultra Bombshell 1.5" Clipless Curling Rod uses dual heaters and ThermaCore™ technology to create long-lasting curls with 395°F even heat, ideal for dry or color-treated hair. It curls in half the time of traditional irons and includes auto shutoff and a heat glove.

curling iron.name: CROC
curling iron.description: The CROC Classic Infrared Flat Iron features black titanium plates, infrared tech for moisture retention, and heat settings up to 450°F. With an ergonomic grip, 9-ft swivel cord, and auto shutoff, it's ideal for smooth, one-pass straightening across all hair types.

curling iron.name: LOreal Professionnel
curling iron.description: L’Oréal’s SteamPod uses steam and an integrated comb to deliver 2x smoother, faster styling with up to 91% less breakage. Featuring 3 heat settings, rotative cord, and a built-in water tank, it’s ideal for straight, wavy, or shiny styles on all hair types.

curling iron.name: Remington
curling iron.description: The Remington Pro 1–1.5" Pearl Ceramic Curling Wand features a conical barrel with crushed pearl coating for smooth, shiny waves. With 9 heat settings, 410°F max, and auto shutoff, it’s great for quick, frizz-free, salon-style curls.

curling iron.name: BIO IONIC
curling iron.description: BIO IONIC’s curling iron features a 2" longer barrel, NanoIonic MX, and Moisturizing Heat® tech for long-lasting, conditioned curls. With far infrared heat, adjustable settings, and swivel cord, it's perfect for long hair and bouncy, healthy waves.

curling iron.name: GHD
curling iron.description: The GHD Curve Soft Curl Iron has a 1.25" barrel and Ultra-Zone™ tech that maintains 365°F for consistent, safe styling. With fast 25-second heat-up, spring clamp, and auto sleep mode, it's ideal for voluminous, long-lasting curls on all hair types.

curling iron.name: T3
curling iron.description: The T3 SinglePass Curl 1.25" features a CeraGloss™ ceramic barrel and smart microchip with 5 heat settings for glossy, long-lasting curls. Designed for all hair lengths, it's ideal for glamorous styles with digital precision and smooth glide.

curling iron.name: Hot Tools
curling iron.description: The Hot Tools CurlBar is ergonomically shaped in a 7-angle design to reduce stylist strain and features a customizable timer. Ideal for pros, this innovative curling iron creates long-lasting curls quickly and comfortably with precision control.

air compressor.name: Porter-Cable
air compressor.description: The Porter-Cable 6 Gallon Oil Free Pancake Compressor delivers 2.6 SCFM at 90 PSI with a 150 PSI max, featuring a lightweight 30 lb pancake-style tank and durable oil-free pump for easy transport and maintenance-free use. Ideal for DIYers and home workshop users.

air compressor.name: Rolair
air compressor.description: The Rolair VT25BIG Direct Drive Air Compressor delivers 6.5 CFM at 90 PSI with a 2.5 HP motor, cast-iron cylinder, and splash lubrication for durability. Its folding handle and flat-free tires enhance jobsite mobility, perfect for heavy-duty contractors.

air compressor.name: Makita
air compressor.description: The Makita MAC5200 Big Bore Air Compressor features a 3.0 HP motor delivering 6.5 CFM at 90 PSI, with a cast-iron pump, roll cage, and oil-lubricated cooling system, ideal for professional contractors needing durable, high-output air supply.

air compressor.name: DEWALT
air compressor.description: The DEWALT 225 PSI Vertical Air Compressor offers 5.0 SCFM at 90 PSI, 78 dBA quiet operation, and vertical storage with a collapsible handle, combining space-saving design and high performance for roofing, framing, and finish nailers.

air compressor.name: Chicago Pneumatic
air compressor.description: The Chicago Pneumatic CP3850 series includes 2.8 hp angle grinders and sanders built for 7” and 9” wheels, featuring a 2,000-hour bevel gear, adjustable exhaust, and anti-vibration handles—ideal for industrial metalwork professionals.

air compressor.name: Quincy Compressor
air compressor.description: The Quincy QGS Rotary Screw Air Compressor ranges from 5 to 100 hp with tank and dryer options, offering quiet operation, low oil carryover, and 8,000-hour lubricant—ideal for continuous-duty use in industrial and manufacturing sectors.

air compressor.name: Ingersoll Rand
air compressor.description: The Ingersoll Rand SS5L5 Single Stage Air Compressor features a 60-gallon vertical tank, 18.1 CFM at 90 PSI, and durable cast-iron construction with 2-year warranty when used with a start-up kit—ideal for serious DIYers and professionals. Price: $1,489.99.

air compressor.name: Sullair
air compressor.description: The Sullair 400HH delivers up to 425 CFM and 200 PSI with CAT or Perkins engines, extended 10-hour runtime, and easy pressure switching in a compact design, ideal for demanding jobsite applications requiring mobility and high airflow.

wood router.name: Axiom
wood router.description: The Axiom Overhead Dust System provides complete mounting hardware, flex-hose, and hose clamps to simplify connecting the ADS220 dust shoe to Axiom CNC routers, ensuring efficient dust collection with minimum 500 CFM airflow.

wood router.name: Rockwell
wood router.description: The Rockwell 10pc T-Shank Blade Set offers versatile replacements for BladeRunner X2, enabling fast blade swaps without tools, ideal for cutting wood, metal, tile, and plastic with smooth or scroll finishes.

wood router.name: WEN
wood router.description: The WEN 15-Amp Variable Speed Plunge Router offers 8,000–23,000 RPM, 1/4 and 1/2-inch bit compatibility, macro/micro adjustment, and comes with a hard case and accessories, ideal for intricate and versatile woodworking.

wood router.name: SKIL
wood router.description: The SKIL 10 Amp Fixed Base Router features 6-speed control, LED work lighting, and ergonomic handles, while the SKIL Router Table SRT1039 offers a router lift and onboard bit storage, perfect for efficient home workshops.

wood router.name: RIDGID
wood router.description: The RIDGID 1-1/2 HP Compact Router features soft start, variable speed, and micro-adjust dial for precision depth control, offering reliability and versatility for detailed routing tasks.

wood router.name: Milwaukee
wood router.description: The Milwaukee M18 FUEL Compact Router delivers 31,000 RPM with a POWERSTATE Brushless Motor, cordless performance matching 1.25 HP corded routers, featuring micro and macro depth adjustments and dual LED lighting.

wood router.name: Makita
wood router.description: The Makita RT0701C Compact Router offers 1-1/4 HP with variable speed (10,000–30,000 RPM), smooth rack-and-pinion depth adjustment, and a slim ergonomic body, built for precision and durability.

wood router.name: Bosch
wood router.description: The Bosch MRF23EVS 2.3 HP Fixed-Base Router features a trigger-controlled handle, 15 Amp motor, Constant Response circuitry, and microfine depth adjustment, perfect for heavy-duty, precise woodworking projects.

solid state drive.name: Apacer
solid state drive.description: The Apacer AS350 PANTHER SATA III SSD offers up to 560MB/s read and 540MB/s write speeds with 3D NAND, SATA III interface, and 1.5 million hours MTBF, ideal for users upgrading for faster bootups and durable performance.

solid state drive.name: Transcend
solid state drive.description: The Transcend SSD230S features 3D NAND, SLC caching, and up to 560MB/s read speed, offering excellent endurance, RAID engine support, and SSD Scope monitoring, ideal for everyday computing upgrades.

solid state drive.name: Silicon Power
solid state drive.description: The Silicon Power Ace A55 utilizes advanced 3D NAND, delivering enhanced reliability, fast boot times, and shockproof durability, perfect for users needing an affordable and efficient laptop or desktop upgrade.

solid state drive.name: PNY
solid state drive.description: The PNY CS900 SATA III SSD provides up to 560MB/s read and 540MB/s write speeds, reliable low-power storage, and a 3-year warranty, making it an ideal, cost-effective HDD replacement for PC users.

solid state drive.name: XPG
solid state drive.description: The XPG SX8200 Pro NVMe SSD features PCIe Gen3x4 speeds up to 3500/3000MB/s, 3D NAND, LDPC ECC, and a 5-year warranty, built for gamers, enthusiasts, and content creators seeking top-tier performance.

solid state drive.name: Crucial
solid state drive.description: The Crucial BX500 SSD boosts system speed with faster boot times and file access, offering easy installation and a 3-year limited warranty, ideal for users wanting an affordable laptop or desktop upgrade.

solid state drive.name: Kingston
solid state drive.description: The Kingston FURY Renegade PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD delivers up to 7,300/7,000MB/s speeds, optional heatsink cooling, and PS5 readiness, perfect for gamers and power users seeking peak performance and reliability.

solid state drive.name: Gigabyte
solid state drive.description: The Gigabyte UD PRO 512GB SSD offers 530MB/s read and 500MB/s write speeds, Toshiba 3D TLC NAND, and DDR3 cache, providing reliable, high-speed SATA storage with a 3-year limited warranty for everyday users.

sleeping bag.name: Valandré
sleeping bag.description: The Valandré SWING CO 850 is a four-season winter sleeping bag featuring high-tech tubular construction and premium 90/10 duck down for exceptional warmth and comfort, perfect for outdoor enthusiasts in cold, rugged conditions.

sleeping bag.name: Snugpak
sleeping bag.description: The Snugpak Basecamp Navigator sleeping bag offers Isofibre® filling, a soft touch, and versatile design that unzips into a quilt, with a comfort range down to 28°F, ideal for campers needing durability and warmth.

sleeping bag.name: Western Mountaineering
sleeping bag.description: The Western Mountaineering AlpinLite is a 20°F, ultralight, wide mummy sleeping bag filled with 850+ fill power goose down and featuring continuous baffles, ideal for three-season backpackers seeking warmth and low weight.

sleeping bag.name: Rab
sleeping bag.description: The Rab Neutrino 400 is a lightweight, three-season mummy sleeping bag filled with 800FP goose down, featuring recycled Pertex® Quantum fabric and trapezoid baffle construction, designed for fast alpine missions.

sleeping bag.name: NEMO
sleeping bag.description: The NEMO Jazz sleeping bag brings bed-like comfort outdoors with a built-in sheet, integrated pad sleeve, featherbed-style quilted top, and Blanket Fold™ draft collar, perfect for luxury campers seeking plush warmth.

sleeping bag.name: Sea to Summit
sleeping bag.description: The Sea to Summit Ascent Down Sleeping Bag offers RDS-certified 750+ Ultra-Dry Down insulation, Free-Flow Zip for ventilation, and a relaxed mummy fit, making it a versatile and weather-resistant three-season choice.

sleeping bag.name: Mountain Hardwear
sleeping bag.description: The Mountain Hardwear Phantom sleeping bag features 800-fill RDS-certified down, Ghost Whisperer recycled shell, and a 0°F rating, built for alpine traverses and backcountry expeditions where warmth and low weight are essential.

sleeping bag.name: Marmot
sleeping bag.description: The Marmot Sawtooth Sleeping Bag uses 650-fill Down Defender insulation with dual-side zippers and an expandable footbox, offering a 15°F rating ideal for cold-season campers seeking comfort and flexibility.

space heater.name: Heat Storm
space heater.description: The Heat Storm Tradesman 1500W Infrared Heater delivers silent, weatherproof infrared heat with a 7' cord and adjustable tripod, ideal for garages, workshops, and patios needing portable, fast, and wind-resistant heating.

space heater.name: Dreo
space heater.description: The Dreo Portable Space Heater uses 1500W PTC ceramic heating to warm rooms in 3 seconds, with 65° oscillation, remote control, and ultra-quiet 40dB operation, perfect for efficient and peaceful home heating.

space heater.name: Pelonis
space heater.description: The Pelonis 1500W Electric Oil Radiator Heater features adjustable thermostat, five heat settings, a 10-hour programmable timer, and a remote control, ideal for users seeking efficient, low-surface-temperature radiant heat.

space heater.name: Honeywell
space heater.description: The Honeywell 360° Surround Heater offers all-around warmth, 360° tip-over safety, overheat protection, and dual heat settings, making it a reliable choice for small to mid-sized room heating with enhanced safety.

space heater.name: Dr. Infrared Heater
space heater.description: The Dr. Infrared Heater DR-968 combines infrared quartz and PTC heating, delivering 60% more heat, ultra-quiet 39dB operation, and comprehensive safety features, ideal for large rooms needing powerful, safe warmth.

space heater.name: De’Longhi
space heater.description: The De’Longhi TRRS0715E Radiant Heater features a digital LED panel, ECO function, 24-hour timer, and delivers 1500W of quiet, allergy-friendly heat with up to 35% more radiant surface, perfect for long-lasting comfort.

space heater.name: Lasko
space heater.description: The Lasko Ceramic Tower Heater offers widespread oscillation, an elongated heating element, programmable thermostat, seven-hour timer, and remote control, ideal for safe, efficient heating of most home rooms.

space heater.name: Dyson
space heater.description: The Dyson Purifier Hot+Cool Formaldehyde combines advanced HEPA H13 purification, catalytic destruction of formaldehyde, Air Multiplier™ technology, and smart app/voice control, perfect for whole-room air quality and heating.

portable air conditioner.name: Toshiba
portable air conditioner.description: The Toshiba 14,000 BTU (10,000 SACC) portable AC features 3-in-1 cooling, fan, and dehumidifier modes, a 24-hour timer, LED display, and auto-restart. Designed for rooms up to 550 sq.ft., it’s ideal for eco-conscious users with its R32 refrigerant and easy portability.

portable air conditioner.name: SereneLife
portable air conditioner.description: The SereneLife 8,000 BTU portable air conditioner offers cooling, fan, and dehumidifier modes with remote control and a window exhaust kit. Compact and energy-efficient, it cools rooms quickly and operates quietly—perfect for small home spaces.

portable air conditioner.name: Friedrich
portable air conditioner.description: The Friedrich ZoneAire Compact 3-in-1 AC includes built-in Wi-Fi, Alexa/Google voice control, and smart app scheduling. With cooling, fan, and dehumidifier modes, it’s ideal for connected users seeking mobile and compact climate control.

portable air conditioner.name: Midea
portable air conditioner.description: The Midea U-shaped window AC offers ultra-quiet operation, inverter efficiency, smart app/voice control, and allows the window to open while installed. It’s Energy Star certified and ideal for energy-savvy users seeking powerful, quiet cooling.

portable air conditioner.name: Hisense
portable air conditioner.description: The Hisense 10,000 BTU portable AC includes Wi-Fi connectivity and a compact single-hose design with replaceable parts and filters. With remote control and drain accessories, it’s well-suited for modern rooms needing mobile climate control.

portable air conditioner.name: BLACKDECKER
portable air conditioner.description: The BLACK+DECKER 8,000 BTU portable AC cools, dehumidifies, and circulates air for rooms up to 150 sq.ft., with LED controls, remote, and rolling casters. Perfect for small spaces like dorms or offices needing simple, quiet comfort.

portable air conditioner.name: Whynter
portable air conditioner.description: The Whynter ARC-12SDH is a 4-in-1 portable AC with heating, cooling, fan, and dehumidifier modes, carbon filter, and dual-hose setup. With 12,000 BTU power for 400 sq.ft., it’s ideal for high humidity zones and year-round home comfort.

portable air conditioner.name: LG
portable air conditioner.description: The LG 3-in-1 portable air conditioner provides heat, cool, and fan functions in one unit, ideal for versatile climate control. Its compact design suits various room sizes, offering year-round comfort in a single appliance.

shampoo.name: Paul Mitchell
shampoo.description: The Paul Mitchell Tea Tree Special Shampoo cleanses with natural tea tree oil, peppermint, and lavender, revitalizing hair and scalp with a refreshing tingle. Priced at £22.69 for 300ml, it’s ideal for those seeking a vegan, paraben-free, color-safe refresh.

shampoo.name: Redken
shampoo.description: The Redken Color Extend line offers shampoos, conditioners, and treatments designed to nourish strands and protect color longevity, making it ideal for anyone aiming to keep their dyed hair vibrant and healthy-looking.

shampoo.name: L'Oréal Paris
shampoo.description: L'Oréal EverPure Sulfate-Free Moisture Shampoo deeply hydrates dry, color-treated hair with rosemary-infused care, offering 2X more moisture and up to 4 weeks of color protection. A great fit for those seeking sulfate-free, gentle cleansing.

shampoo.name: Garnier
shampoo.description: The Garnier Fructis Grow Strong Shampoo fortifies hair with apple extract and niacinamide, promoting moisture, smoothness, and detangling without parabens or phthalates. Perfect for those aiming to resist breakage and enhance strength.

shampoo.name: Dove
shampoo.description: Dove Intensive Repair Shampoo, powered by Bio-Nourish Complex, targets damaged hair and helps repair up to 98% of daily breakage, making it a go-to for users needing intense nourishment and restoration.

shampoo.name: Herbal Essences
shampoo.description: Herbal Essences Hello Hydration Shampoo infuses hair with deep moisture and a coconut scent, offering a paraben-free, dermatologist-tested formula that's perfect for those seeking smooth, soft hair with tropical vibes.

shampoo.name: Matrix
shampoo.description: Matrix Brass Off Shampoo neutralizes brassy tones with balancing blue-violet pigments, ideal for brunettes who lighten their hair and want cooler, refreshed tones in both natural and color-treated styles.

shampoo.name: Pantene
shampoo.description: Pantene Daily Moisture Renewal Shampoo locks in moisture without weighing hair down, delivering clinically proven healthier hair with every wash. It’s gentle like sulfate-free formulas and ideal for multitasking hair care routines.

leaf blower.name: Makita
leaf blower.description: The Makita cordless blower delivers 120 MPH and 473 CFM using two 18V LXT batteries with a brushless motor and 6-stage air volume dial. Weighing 9 lbs with batteries and emitting just 61 dB(A), it’s perfect for quiet, powerful yard cleanup.

leaf blower.name: WORX
leaf blower.description: The WORX TURBINE electric blower pushes up to 600 CFM and 110 MPH using turbine fan tech, a Hyper-Stream nozzle, and variable speed control. Lightweight at 6.4 lbs, it's ideal for high-capacity residential leaf clearing.

leaf blower.name: BlackDecker
leaf blower.description: The BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX Sweeper clears hard surfaces with up to 130 MPH airspeed in a lightweight 3.7 lb design. Quiet and cordless, it’s perfect for driveways, garages, decks, and quick yard touch-ups.

leaf blower.name: DeWalt
leaf blower.description: The DeWalt 20V MAX Brushless Handheld Blower delivers 450 CFM and 125 MPH with a variable speed trigger and speed lock. Lightweight and ergonomic, it’s great for efficient yard work with controlled airflow.

leaf blower.name: Ryobi
leaf blower.description: The RYOBI ONE+ 18V Cordless Blower delivers 200 CFM at 90 MPH, optimized for hard surfaces. Its lightweight, compact design and cordless convenience make it great for quick, maneuverable cleanup tasks.

leaf blower.name: Husqvarna
leaf blower.description: The Husqvarna 125B handheld blower offers 470 CFM and 170 MPH power at only 9.4 lbs. With air purge for easy starts, multi-speed control, and ergonomic design, it’s built for efficient yard maintenance with comfort in mind.

leaf blower.name: Stihl
leaf blower.description: The STIHL BR 800 X MAGNUM backpack blower features a 4.4 hp engine and anti-vibration system for pro-grade comfort and performance. Its ergonomic harness, tool-free adjustments, and 4-MIX® engine make it ideal for large property cleanup.

leaf blower.name: Poulan Pro
leaf blower.description: The Poulan Pro PR48BT backpack blower boasts a 48cc engine delivering 475 CFM at 200 MPH, with cruise control, ergonomic harness, and soft-grip handles. Built for year-round cleanups across large yards with wet or heavy debris.

computer monitor.name: MSI
computer monitor.description: The MSI Optix MAG274QRF-QD is a 27" WQHD gaming monitor with a 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms GTG response, Quantum Dot color, and G-Sync compatibility. Featuring Rapid IPS, HDR, USB-C, and Mystic Light, it's ideal for immersive, tear-free esports gaming.

computer monitor.name: AOC
computer monitor.description: The AOC C32G2E is a 32" curved gaming monitor with a 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response time, and AMD FreeSync for tear-free gameplay. Its frameless design, low input lag mode, and game-specific presets make it ideal for immersive and competitive gaming.

computer monitor.name: Philips
computer monitor.description: The Philips B Line 34" curved UltraWide monitor features USB-C, ergonomic stand, and TUV-certified eye comfort for reduced fatigue. Ideal for multitaskers and professionals needing expansive workspace with wraparound immersion.

computer monitor.name: ViewSonic
computer monitor.description: The ViewSonic TD2455 is a 24" Full HD in-cell touch monitor with USB-C, ergonomic stand, and stylus support. Featuring 10-point PCAP touch and DisplayPort MST, it’s perfect for offices, classrooms, and presentation hubs.

computer monitor.name: Acer
computer monitor.description: The Acer Nitro XV272U RV is a 27" WQHD gaming monitor with a 170Hz refresh rate, 1ms response, 95% DCI-P3 color, and AMD FreeSync Premium. Ideal for gamers seeking color accuracy, fluid motion, and ergonomic flexibility.

computer monitor.name: Asus
computer monitor.description: The ASUS ROG Swift PG259QN is a 24.5" FHD gaming monitor with 360Hz refresh rate, 1ms GTG, NVIDIA G-SYNC, and HDR10. Built for pro esports, it combines Fast IPS tech and advanced cooling for ultra-smooth competitive play.

computer monitor.description: The LG UltraGear 27GN750 is a 27" FHD gaming monitor with 240Hz refresh rate, 1ms IPS response, HDR10, and 99% sRGB color. With G-Sync compatibility and Black Stabilizer, it's perfect for fast-paced, color-rich gaming.

computer monitor.name: Dell
computer monitor.description: The Dell UltraSharp 27" monitor features IPS Black tech, 4K UHD resolution, 100% sRGB/Rec.709 color, and a full connectivity hub with USB-C and LAN. Ideal for creatives and professionals seeking high color fidelity and productivity.

blender.name: Tefal
blender.description: The Tefal PerfectMix+ Blender features a 1200W motor and Powelix Life titanium-coated blades for 30% faster blending, with three pre-set modes and a durable 1.5L Tritan jar. Its air cooling system and vortex-enhancing blade geometry make it ideal for families seeking smooth results and lasting performance.

blender.name: Smeg
blender.description: The Smeg 4-in-1 Hand Blender in pastel blue includes a stainless steel immersion blender, chopper, potato masher, and whisk, powered by a 700W motor with Turbo mode and adjustable speeds. It’s a stylish, multi-functional tool ideal for compact kitchens and everyday meal prep.

blender.name: Oster
blender.description: The Oster Pro 1200 Blender delivers 1200 watts with 7 speeds, dual-direction Crush Pro 6™ blades, and pre-programmed settings for smoothies and salsas. It includes a 6-cup glass jar and two 24 oz. smoothie cups—ideal for home chefs who want power, convenience, and portability.

blender.name: KitchenAid
blender.description: The KitchenAid Diamond Blender features Intelli-Speed control and a durable 1.75L BPA-free pitcher, blending with precision using a diamond vortex and patented stainless steel blades. blender.name: Breville
blender.description: Breville’s Fresh & Furious Blender offers 9 task controls with pre-sets for smoothies and ice crush, a surgical-grade blade, and a quiet, high-torque motor. The LCD timer and Vac Q compatibility make it ideal for users wanting texture-enhanced results with minimal noise.

blender.description: The Hamilton Beach Wave Crusher Blender features a 700W motor and patented Wave-Action® system for smooth blends, plus a 40 oz. glass jar and 20 oz. travel cup. With 12 functions, it's perfect for families and individuals who need versatile, on-the-go blending.

blender.name: Blendtec
blender.description: The Blendtec Designer 650 S blender boasts a 1560W motor, touchscreen controls, 6 blend cycles, and 8 manual speeds. Paired with the WildSide+ jar for high-efficiency blending, it’s perfect for prosumers seeking premium performance, modern design, and an 8-year warranty.

blender.name: Ninja
blender.description: The Ninja Foodi Power Blender & Processor System combines a 1400W smartTORQUE motor, 6 Auto-iQ programs, and three versatile vessels to blend, chop, and mix with precision. With smoothie and dough-making features, it’s ideal for users wanting a high-power all-in-one kitchen solution.

hammock.name: Pawleys Island
hammock.description: The Pawleys Island Large Quilted Hammock features dual-layer Sunbrella and DURACORD® fabric, oak spreader bars, and non-absorbent polyester fiberfill. Handmade in the Carolinas, it's weather-resistant and ideal for stylish two-person backyard lounging. Price: $299.99.

hammock.name: Yellow Leaf
hammock.description: The Yellow Leaf Signature Hammock is handwoven with 150,000 ultra-soft loops for unmatched comfort and versatility. Feathersoft, weather-resistant, and easily portable, it’s perfect for travel, beach, or backyard relaxation. Capacity: up to 550 lbs.

hammock.name: Duracord
hammock.description: The DURACORD® Small Rope Hammock in Oatmeal offers weather-resistant comfort with soft yet durable synthetic rope. Its compact size and sturdy build make it ideal for relaxing in smaller outdoor spaces with long-lasting charm.

hammock.name: Warbonnet
hammock.description: The Warbonnet Ridgerunner Hammock is a top-rated, flat lay bridge-style hammock with optional underquilts and accessories. Designed for comfort and customization, it’s perfect for seasoned campers and backpackers seeking modular sleeping systems.

hammock.name: Vivere
hammock.description: The Vivere Universal Hammock Stand with Double Hammock pairs breathable 100% cotton fabric with a heavy-duty steel frame. Tool-free setup, zinc-coated legs, and a carry bag make it ideal for both patio lounging and travel adventures.

hammock.name: Hennessy
hammock.description: The Hennessy Expedition Classic Hammock includes built-in mosquito netting, rainfly, and patented asymmetrical design for flat, ergonomic sleeping. Durable and lightweight, it's a go-to option for serious campers and backpackers.

hammock.name: ENO
hammock.description: The ENO SingleNest Hammock uses soft, breathable FreeWave® nylon and triple-stitched seams for durability and comfort. Lightweight and compact, it’s perfect for solo outdoor adventures, rated to support up to 400 lbs.

hammock.name: Castaway Living
hammock.description: The Castaway Living Antique Brown Rope Hammock features dense 8mm polyester rope for support and hardwood spreader bars with countersunk holes. With included chains and tree hooks, it's ready to hang and built for long-lasting comfort.

tent.name: Snugpak

tent.name: TETON Sports
tent.description: The TETON Sports Mountain Ultra Tent offers waterproof 2-person shelter with 2 doors, built-in ventilation, heat-sealed seams, and an easy 1-person setup, ideal for lightweight backpackers seeking durability and simplicity.

tent.name: Terra Nova
tent.description: The Terra Nova Southern Cross 1 is a freestanding, four-season, one-person tent with fast pitching, a spacious vestibule, and full waterproofing, built for year-round backpacking adventures.

tent.name: Mountain Hardwear
tent.description: The Mountain Hardwear Mineral King 2 Tent features oversized doors for panoramic views, adaptable fly for stargazing, DAC Pressfit poles, and a lightweight waterproof build, perfect for campers wanting livable comfort and scenery.

tent.name: Zpacks
tent.description: The Zpacks Duplex is an ultralight two-person trekking pole tent weighing just 20 oz, crafted for minimalist adventurers seeking trail-tested durability and award-winning minimalist design.

tent.name: The North Face
tent.description: The North Face Stormbreak 2 is a roomy two-person tent featuring large doors, twin-zip vestibules, high-low ventilation, and easy-pitch design, built for classic, comfortable camping experiences.

tent.name: Marmot
tent.description: The Marmot Limelight 2P Tent offers a roomy 2-person design with pre-bent poles, dual vestibules, bathtub floor, and included footprint, providing spacious, durable shelter for three-season camping.

tent.name: NEMO
tent.description: The NEMO Dragonfly OSMO Ultralight Tent features sustainable, PFAS-free fabric, asymmetrical vestibules, gear loft, Nightlight Pockets™, and ultralight construction, ideal for serious backpackers seeking performance and packability.

lipstick.name: Anastasia Beverly Hills
lipstick.description: Anastasia Beverly Hills Liquid Lipstick delivers long-lasting, smudge-proof matte color with a full-pigment formula and precise applicator. Comfortable and customizable, it's perfect for all-day wear and even doubles as blush.

lipstick.name: Charlotte Tilbury
lipstick.description: Charlotte Tilbury's Pillow Talk collection offers universally flattering nude-pink lipsticks, eyeshadows, and blushes for day-to-disco looks. With iconic shades and push-up effect mascara, it's designed for dreamy beauty in every skin tone.

lipstick.name: Too Faced
lipstick.description: Too Faced Melted Matte Lipstick features 8-hour wear, a plumping no-sting formula with avocado oil and hyaluronic spheres, and a smooth, weightless feel. The angled applicator ensures bold, ultra-matte color without dryness.

lipstick.name: NARS
lipstick.description: NARS Audacious Lipstick provides single-stroke, satin-finish coverage in bold, long-lasting shades. Its creamy texture hydrates while preventing feathering—ideal for statement lips with luxurious feel and intense pigment.

lipstick.name: Revlon
lipstick.description: Revlon ColorStay Matte Lite Crayon is a smudge-proof, water-resistant matte lipstick that's 30% lighter than average. Infused with mango seed oil and packed in a precise crayon with built-in sharpener, it's made for bold, comfortable wear.

lipstick.name: L'Oréal Paris
lipstick.description: L'Oréal Paris Colour Riche Intense Volume Matte Lipstick offers 16-hour bold color with hyaluronic acid for fuller, hydrated lips. Its slim bullet and non-drying finish ensure precise, all-day comfort and plumping effect.

lipstick.name: MAC
lipstick.description: MAC Love Me Lipstick infuses argan oil for all-day moisture with a weightless, satin finish. With vibrant reds, flattering neutrals, and expressive bolds, it's made to empower self-expression in every swipe.

lipstick.name: Maybelline
lipstick.description: Maybelline Super Stay Matte Ink lasts up to 16 hours with a no-transfer formula and arrow applicator. Available in 36 shades, it offers intense matte color and a flawless finish for all-day confidence.

barbecue grill.name: Blackstone
barbecue grill.description: The Blackstone 17" Tabletop Griddle delivers 12,000 BTUs via an H-style burner for even heat, with a portable design perfect for tailgates or camping. Its hood and Rear Grease Management System simplify cleanup, ideal for outdoor cooks seeking compact power.

barbecue grill.name: Pit Boss
barbecue grill.description: The Pit Boss Classic Pellet Grill offers 700 sq. in. of porcelain-coated space and 8-in-1 versatility from 180–500°F. With a digital controller and flame broiler, it’s perfect for wood-fired grilling, smoking, and more, for groups of 4–6.

barbecue grill.name: Big Green Egg
barbecue grill.description: The MiniMax Big Green Egg is a compact ceramic grill with 133 sq. in. of cooking space, built for portability with an easy-grip carrier. Ideal for tailgates and camping, it delivers premium performance in a small, durable form.

barbecue grill.name: Kamado Joe
barbecue grill.description: The Kamado Joe Classic Joe II is a 46 cm ceramic charcoal grill with 1613 cm² of space, featuring the Air Lift Hinge, Kontrol Tower vent, and Divide & Conquer system. Built for precision and ease, it’s ideal for grill enthusiasts ready to elevate their game.

barbecue grill.name: Traeger
barbecue grill.description: The Traeger Pro 780 is a wood pellet grill with 780 sq. in. of space, WiFIRE® app control, and TurboTemp® tech for fast, consistent cooking. Ideal for smoking, roasting, or baking, it suits tech-savvy grillers seeking wood-fired flavor and smart features.

barbecue grill.name: Char-Broil
barbecue grill.description: The Char-Broil 4-Burner Gas Grill delivers 32,000 BTUs with an added 10,000 BTU side burner, porcelain-coated grates, and electronic ignition. With storage and mobility features, it’s great for backyard chefs wanting performance and convenience.

barbecue grill.name: Weber
barbecue grill.description: The Weber Spirit E-310 Gas Grill offers 424 sq. in. of grilling space, porcelain-enameled grates, six tool hooks, and a grease management system. Durable and user-friendly, it’s perfect for family meals and casual grillers.

barbecue grill.name: Broil King
barbecue grill.description: The Broil King Baron S 490 PRO IR features 460 sq. in. of cooking space, 4 stainless burners, Flav-R-Wave™ system, infrared side burner, and illuminated controls. Built for durability and performance, it’s ideal for grillers who want premium versatility.

hair dryer.name: Parlux
hair dryer.description: The Parlux Advance Light Ionic and Ceramic Hair Dryer features a 2,200W K-ADVANCE motor, ionic and ceramic tech, and 4 heat/2 speed settings. Weighing just 460g, it delivers fast, frizz-free styling with Italian-engineered durability.

hair dryer.name: Elchim
hair dryer.description: The Elchim hair dryer delivers 2400W of power with ionic ceramic tech to reduce frizz and static while hydrating hair. Lightweight, quiet, and award-winning, it’s ideal for salon-grade results with over 30% faster drying.

hair dryer.name: ghd
hair dryer.description: The ghd air® professional hair dryer offers a 1600W salon-strength motor, ionic tech, and ergonomic design. With adjustable heat/speed and a concentrator nozzle, it delivers smooth, shiny blowouts twice as fast as regular dryers.

hair dryer.name: BaBylissPRO
hair dryer.description: The BaBylissPRO Nano Titanium dryer packs 2000W of power, an ion generator, 6 heat/speed settings, and a removable filter into a lightweight, ergonomic frame—perfect for fast, customizable styling with smooth results.

hair dryer.name: Remington
hair dryer.description: The Remington ONE™ dryer includes 3 attachments for smoothing and curls, plus ionic conditioning for 90% less frizz and 25% faster drying. Its compact, lightweight design and 8 heat/speed settings suit all hair types.

hair dryer.name: Panasonic
hair dryer.description: The Panasonic EH-NA27 nanoe Compact Dryer infuses moisture-rich ions to reduce frizz and enhance shine. With 1400W power, 3 airflow settings, and a foldable handle, it’s perfect for fast, on-the-go styling.

hair dryer.name: Conair
hair dryer.description: The Conair Double Ceramic Dryer uses 1875W and dual ceramic tech for gentle, even heat with 3 heat/2 speed settings. Its ionic output tames frizz while a concentrator and cool shot help lock in sleek styles.

hair dryer.name: Dyson
hair dryer.description: The Dyson Supersonic™ hair dryer features a 110,000rpm digital motor, Air Multiplier™ tech, 4 heat/3 speed settings, and 5 magnetic styling tools. Engineered for fast drying without extreme heat, it suits all hair types.

network attached storage.name: ioSafe
network attached storage.description: The ioSafe 218 NAS is a fireproof, waterproof 2-bay RAID 1 storage system with Synology DSM OS and up to 24TB capacity. Designed for data survival, it withstands 1550°F for 30 minutes and 10 ft water submersion for 72 hours—ideal for disaster-proof backup.

network attached storage.name: Fujitsu
network attached storage.description: The Fujitsu ETERNUS AF250 S3 is a scalable all-flash array with up to 8,110 TB capacity, 600K IOPS, and 99.9999% uptime. With deduplication, QoS automation, and failover support, it's ideal for Tier-1 applications in mid-sized enterprises.

network attached storage.name: TerraMaster
network attached storage.description: The TerraMaster F2-221 is a compact 2-bay NAS for personal cloud storage, powered by a 1.4GHz quad-core ARM CPU and 2GB RAM. With Gigabit LAN and RAID support, it’s an affordable solution for home users seeking secure, remote-accessible storage.

network attached storage.name: Zyxel
network attached storage.description: Zyxel Personal Cloud Storage enables easy access to files across devices with strong media streaming and remote sharing features. It’s ideal for expanding home libraries or small network environments needing flexible, cloud-ready storage.

network attached storage.name: Seagate
network attached storage.description: Seagate’s 16TB Exos X16 and IronWolf drives offer enterprise-grade density and performance for hyperscale and NAS. The helium-based Exos is optimized for data centers, while IronWolf drives are perfect for robust, always-on NAS workloads up to 300TB/year.

network attached storage.name: Buffalo
network attached storage.description: Buffalo’s TeraStation 5810DN is an 8-bay 10GbE NAS with RAID, rsync, VMware-ready support, and hot-swap drives. Powered by a quad-core CPU with ECC RAM, it’s built for fast, secure business storage with cloud sync and Active Directory integration.

network attached storage.name: Synology
network attached storage.description: The Synology FS3600 is a 24-bay all-flash NAS delivering 195K iSCSI 4K random write IOPS via a 12-core CPU and high-speed networking. Built for databases, VMs, and OLTP, it's perfect for I/O-intensive enterprise workloads.

network attached storage.name: Infortrend
network attached storage.description: The Infortrend EonStor GSe Pro 3000 is a unified SMB storage system with cloud integration, scale-out expansion up to 16PB, and modular host board slots. It’s ideal for businesses planning for future data growth with flexible deployment needs.

portable speaker.name: Tribit
portable speaker.description: The Tribit StormBox Micro 2 is a rugged, pocket-sized Bluetooth speaker delivering 10W sound with deep bass via XBASS technology, 12-hour battery life, and a 120-ft Bluetooth 5.3 range. It doubles as a power bank and features IP67 water and dust resistance, ideal for travelers and outdoor enthusiasts.

portable speaker.name: Harman Kardon
portable speaker.description: The Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 7 blends immersive stereo sound with elegant design, featuring dual tweeters, Bluetooth pairing for two devices, and an 8-hour battery in a sleek, portable frame. Aimed at audiophiles seeking refined acoustics and stylish portability.

portable speaker.name: Ultimate Ears
portable speaker.description: The Ultimate Ears BOOM 3 delivers balanced 360° audio with deep bass and 15-hour battery life in a rugged, waterproof IP67 build. Covered in durable, two-tone performance fabric, it's designed for music lovers who want durability and premium sound on the go.

portable speaker.name: Marshall
portable speaker.description: The Marshall Emberton II is a compact portable Bluetooth speaker offering over 30 hours of playtime and rich sound in a rugged design. Priced at $169.99, it suits users looking for iconic style and long-lasting performance.

portable speaker.name: soundcore
portable speaker.description: The soundcore 3 Bluetooth speaker features dual titanium drivers for high-fidelity treble up to 40kHz, enhanced BassUp tech, 16W stereo sound, and 24-hour playtime. With IPX7 waterproofing, it’s ideal for outdoor listeners and long trips.

portable speaker.name: JBL
portable speaker.description: The JBL Flip 6 delivers powerful two-way sound with a racetrack woofer, separate tweeter, and dual passive radiators, alongside 12-hour playtime and IP67 water and dust protection. It’s built for parties, travel, and outdoor fun.

portable speaker.name: Bose
portable speaker.description: The Bose SoundLink Revolve II offers immersive 360° sound with a down-firing transducer and dual passive radiators, up to 13 hours of playtime, and voice assistant access. Water-resistant and impact-resistant, it's perfect for everyday carry and deep-listening experiences.

lawn mower.name: Bobcat
lawn mower.description: The Bobcat ZT6000e is a commercial-grade electric zero-turn mower with a 4–6+ hour runtime, AirFX™ cutting deck, and three electric motors. With low maintenance, zero emissions, and touchscreen controls, it’s built for pro-level performance and comfort.

lawn mower.name: Snapper
lawn mower.description: The Snapper HD 48V MAX system includes a 20" steel-deck push and self-propelled mower with up to 90 minutes of runtime, 3-in-1 mulching/discharge/bagging, and intelligent load sensing—ideal for quiet, compact, battery-powered yard care.

lawn mower.name: Gravely
lawn mower.description: The Gravely Pro-Turn Z features commercial-grade build, seat isolation, and suspension forks for reduced fatigue. With a Kawasaki FS engine, it's designed for all-day comfort and powerful, mid-duty mowing at a competitive price.

lawn mower.name: Troy-Bilt
lawn mower.description: The Troy-Bilt Pony 42 riding mower includes a 42" cutting deck, 7-speed Shift-on-the-Go™ transmission, and Step-Thru™ frame for easy access. Its AGM battery ensures reliable starting for efficient lawn maintenance.

lawn mower.name: WORX
lawn mower.description: The WORX Landroid robotic mower auto-schedules based on lawn size, features patented AIA tech for narrow paths, and adapts via over-the-air updates. Powered by a 20V POWERSHARE™ battery, it’s smart, customizable, and ideal for up to 1,000m² lawns.

lawn mower.name: RYOBI
lawn mower.description: The RYOBI 20" Bagging Blade enhances mulching and bagging efficiency on 40V cordless mowers. Designed for RY401 series models, it creates finer clippings, increasing runtime and cutting performance for electric mower users.

lawn mower.name: Husqvarna
lawn mower.description: The Husqvarna W520 features a 20" cut width, variable-speed AutoWalk drive, Kawasaki FJ180 KAI engine, and aluminum chassis. With BBC control, ergonomic design, and high-capacity bagging, it’s built for professional walk-behind use.

lawn mower.name: Ariens
lawn mower.description: The Ariens IKON 52 with Kawasaki engine is a premium zero-turn mower designed for residential use, offering durability, wide cutting width, and commercial-grade performance at an accessible price point.

robot vacuum.name: BISSELL
robot vacuum.description: The BISSELL EV675 Robot Vacuum features a Triple-Action Cleaning System with dual edge brushes, rotating brush roll, and strong suction. It adapts to carpets and hard floors, runs up to 100 minutes, and includes cliff sensors and remote-scheduled cleaning—ideal for pet owners and busy households.

robot vacuum.name: Miele
robot vacuum.description: Miele offers a range of high-end robot vacuums with advanced features for efficient cleaning, available through their Miele Experience Centres across Canada. These products target premium users seeking quality craftsmanship and connected smart home integration.

robot vacuum.name: ILIFE
robot vacuum.description: The ILIFE PX-F031 High Performance Filter 8-pack is compatible with A80 Max, A9, A10, and S8 Pro robot vacuums. Priced at $14.99, it's a cost-effective choice for users seeking reliable dust and allergen filtration for their ILIFE vacuum models.

robot vacuum.name: Samsung
robot vacuum.description: The Samsung Bespoke Jet Bot AI+ uses Intel AI and 3D LiDAR to navigate intelligently, avoid obstacles, and personalize cleaning paths. With SmartThings integration and pet monitoring, it's ideal for tech-savvy users and pet owners wanting advanced floor care automation.

robot vacuum.name: Xiaomi
robot vacuum.description: The Mi Robot Vacuum-Mop 2 combines 2700Pa suction, pressurized mopping, and smart navigation for deep cleaning. With a 110-minute battery life and app-controlled zoning, it suits users looking for efficient, customizable cleaning of medium to large homes.

robot vacuum.name: Eufy
robot vacuum.description: The Eufy X10 Pro Omni features 8000Pa suction, sonic mopping, and a self-maintaining base that handles emptying, washing, drying, and refilling. Designed for full automation, it's ideal for hands-free users seeking premium cleaning at a competitive price.

robot vacuum.name: Ecovacs
robot vacuum.description: The DEEBOT OZMO 920 offers simultaneous vacuuming and mopping, laser mapping, and customizable cleaning with Smart Navi 3.0. Its slim design and app control make it perfect for users needing quiet, efficient multi-floor cleaning with detailed scheduling.

robot vacuum.name: Shark
robot vacuum.description: Shark’s Matrix™ Plus 2-in-1 series delivers deep carpet vacuuming and sonic mopping, with self-emptying, HEPA filtration, and corner-cleaning tech. With up to 120 minutes runtime and smart obstacle avoidance, it’s built for allergy-sensitive users and tech-forward homes.

pressure washer.name: Stanley
pressure washer.description: The Stanley FATMAX Gas Pressure Washer features a 149cc KOHLER engine and 12" never-flat wheels for easy mobility, delivering strong cleaning performance with a 35' MorFlex hose, four spray nozzles, and a vertical axial cam pump. Ideal for professionals seeking portable, durable pressure cleaning power.

pressure washer.name: MTM Hydro
pressure washer.description: The MTM Hydro PF22 Foam Cannon is a high-performance, Italian-made car and surface cleaning tool supporting up to 5000 PSI and 5.3 GPM, with adjustable fan spray, dual nozzle angles, and precise chemical mixing. Designed for professionals and auto detailers who demand premium foam coverage.

pressure washer.name: Stihl
pressure washer.description: The Stihl RE 90 is a lightweight, compact electric pressure washer delivering up to 120 bar pressure with a 6 m hose, fan jet and rotary nozzles, detergent spray, and integrated wheels. Perfect for homeowners looking for efficient outdoor surface cleaning with user-friendly storage and controls.

pressure washer.name: Westinghouse
pressure washer.description: The Westinghouse WPX2700 is a gas-powered 2700 PSI washer with a 2.3 GPM flow rate, 4 nozzle tips, and a 212cc OHV engine, built for deep cleaning surfaces from concrete to vehicles. Includes soap tank and rugged wheels, ideal for heavy-duty outdoor use.

pressure washer.name: DEWALT
pressure washer.description: The DEWALT DWPW2400 delivers 2400 PSI and 1.1 GPM with five quick-connect nozzles, an onboard soap tank, and 10" pneumatic wheels for jobsite portability. CETA certified and equipped with a kink-resistant hose, it’s suited for home and light commercial cleaning tasks.

pressure washer.name: Karcher
pressure washer.description: The Kärcher K5 Premium is a 2000 PSI electric pressure washer featuring a water-cooled induction motor, hose reel, 26 ft hose, and DirtBlaster wand for surface-friendly power cleaning. Built for durable, quiet operation, it's ideal for high-demand home users.

pressure washer.name: Generac
pressure washer.description: The Generac 2900 PSI Gas Pressure Washer combines a 196cc OHV engine with an axial cam pump, ergonomic spray gun, and 25' hose, all on oversized never-flat tires for mobility. Designed for reliable, high-power cleaning across varied outdoor surfaces.

pressure washer.name: Mi-T-M
pressure washer.description: The Mi-T-M CD-1002-3MUH is a 1000 PSI electric pressure washer with a forged brass manifold, enclosed 1.5 HP motor, and 2.0 GPM flow rate, designed for light-duty cleaning with a 25' hose and detergent injector. Ideal for users needing controlled, precise washing on delicate surfaces.

microwave oven.name: GE
microwave oven.description: The GE HMC920BEWW is a 0.9 cu. ft., 900-watt microwave with built-in WiFi powered by SmartHQ™, offering real-time performance feedback and remote control. Compact and tech-enabled, it's great for small kitchens with smart home integration.

microwave oven.name: Breville
microwave oven.description: The Breville Compact Wave Soft Close is a 25L microwave with one-touch buttons, food menu shortcuts, and an 80% quieter soft-close door. It includes reheat, defrost, and child lock functions—perfect for quiet, intuitive kitchen use.

microwave oven.name: Farberware
microwave oven.description: This 1.2 cu. ft., 900-watt microwave in Black Stainless Steel features sensor reheating, 10 power levels up to 1100W, programmable favorites, and an easy-grip handle. It’s an ideal choice for apartments and office break rooms.

microwave oven.name: Sharp
microwave oven.description: The Sharp SMC1452CH is a 1.4 cu. ft. microwave in black stainless steel with 1100 watts of power and LED interior lighting. Combining elegant design with powerful performance, it’s built for stylish, efficient family kitchens.

microwave oven.name: Panasonic
microwave oven.description: The Panasonic NN-SN966SR features 1250 watts, 2.2 cu. ft. capacity, Inverter Technology, and Genius Sensor cooking with 14 auto settings. It offers even heating, Turbo Defrost, and Keep Warm—ideal for large households seeking precision.

microwave oven.name: LG
microwave oven.description: The LG NeoChef™ 2.0 cu. ft. Countertop Microwave uses Smart Inverter tech and a 6-wheel stabilizer ring for balance. With EasyClean® and stylish black stainless steel, it’s designed for durable, even heating and easy cleaning.

microwave oven.name: Galanz
microwave oven.description: The Galanz Retro Microwave offers 0.7 cu. ft. capacity, 700W power, 6 levels, and vintage design in multiple colors. With eco mode, chrome handle, and LED display, it’s a fun and functional fit for small spaces or retro decor lovers.

microwave oven.name: Toshiba
microwave oven.description: This Toshiba microwave features a stainless steel front, digital display, 10 power levels, 8 auto-cook modes, and express and defrost functions. Its sleek handle and modern design make it a user-friendly, upscale kitchen addition.

dishwasher.name: Miele
dishwasher.description: The Miele dishwasher features QuickIntenseWash for full cleaning in under 60 minutes, EcoPower tech for reduced water and energy use, and ComfortClose door. Its FlexLine baskets and adjustable racks make it ideal for efficient, hygienic, and quiet dish care.

dishwasher.name: KitchenAid
dishwasher.description: KitchenAid's dishwasher offers a FreeFlex™ Third Rack, Advanced Clean Water Wash, and ProWash™ Cycle. With 44 dBA quiet performance, fingerprint-resistant finish, and top controls, it's perfect for households wanting flexible, spotless cleaning in a sleek design.

dishwasher.name: Maytag
dishwasher.description: The Maytag dishwasher features Dual Power Filtration and PowerBlast® cycle to eliminate soaking and scrubbing. A full stainless steel tub, touch controls, and 10-year warranty make it ideal for tough loads and long-term reliability.

dishwasher.name: Whirlpool
dishwasher.description: Whirlpool's dishwasher includes a 3rd rack, adjustable 2nd rack, sensor cycle, and folding tines for versatile loading. With Sani Rinse, Quick Wash, and Soak & Clean options, it's great for busy families needing fast, flexible cleaning.

dishwasher.name: Avanti
dishwasher.description: The Avanti 24" dishwasher fits 12 place settings and offers 5 cycles, ADA compliance, and quiet 57 dBA operation. Ideal for compact spaces like apartments, condos, or offices seeking efficient, space-saving dishwashing.

dishwasher.name: Frigidaire
dishwasher.description: Frigidaire’s Professional Series dishwasher combines powerful cleaning and sleek stainless steel styling, ideal for users seeking pro-grade performance in everyday kitchen use.

dishwasher.name: Haier
dishwasher.description: Haier’s ENERGY STAR® Smart Dishwasher features WiFi connectivity via SmartHQ™, sanitize cycle, and stainless steel interior. It's perfect for modern households wanting performance, quiet operation, and smart control at a great value.

dishwasher.name: Fisher Paykel
dishwasher.description: Fisher Paykel’s Double DishDrawer™ dishwasher offers independent drawer operation, quick wash, sanitize, and extra dry settings. With ergonomic loading and quiet performance, it's ideal for premium kitchens focused on versatility and design.

laptop.name: Purism
laptop.description: The Purism Librem 14 is a privacy-focused 14" laptop with a Core i7-10710U, up to 64GB RAM, and PureOS GNU/Linux. Featuring kill switches, tamper-evident hardware, and Librem Key integration, it's ideal for users seeking maximum digital security and open-source freedom.

laptop.name: Razer
laptop.description: The Razer Blade Stealth 13 is an ultraportable gaming ultrabook with an 11th Gen Intel i7 CPU, GTX 1650 Ti GPU, and options for a 120Hz FHD or OLED touch display. Built for gaming and creation, it features Thunderbolt 4, Wi-Fi 6, and THX spatial audio.

laptop.name: Huawei
laptop.description: The Huawei MateBook 14 features a 2K FullView display, 11th Gen Intel i7, and Super Device integration for seamless cross-device collaboration. At just 1.49 kg, it’s perfect for productivity with strong battery life, privacy camera, and fast charging.

laptop.name: MSI
laptop.description: The MSI GT76 Titan is a 17.3" desktop-replacement laptop with a 9th Gen Intel Core i9 CPU, RTX 2080 SUPER GPU, and support for up to 128GB RAM. With Thunderbolt 3, 4K or 240Hz display options, and dual 230W adapters, it's ideal for elite gaming and content creation.

laptop.name: Apple
laptop.description: Apple’s MacBook Air with M2 chip features an 8-core CPU, up to 10-core GPU, Liquid Retina display, and MagSafe 3. Starting at $1,099, it offers sleek design, all-day battery, and unified memory for fluid multitasking—ideal for everyday creatives and students.

laptop.name: ASUS
laptop.description: The ASUS ZenBook 14 is an ultrathin 14" laptop with 21-hour battery life, 11th Gen Intel CPU, and Thunderbolt 4. Featuring AI noise cancelation, NumberPad 2.0, and Harman Kardon audio, it's perfect for productivity and video conferencing on the go.

laptop.name: Acer
laptop.description: The Acer Aspire 5 pairs 13th Gen Intel Core CPUs with optional RTX graphics, a 16:10 display, and TwinAir Cooling. With Wi-Fi 6E, Thunderbolt 4, and AI-powered conferencing features, it’s a versatile laptop for multitaskers and casual creators.

laptop.name: Fujitsu
laptop.description: The Fujitsu LIFEBOOK U9311X is a 13.3" 2-in-1 convertible with up to i7-1185G7, 32GB RAM, and PalmSecure sensor. Weighing just 1.01 kg with 360° foldability, it’s built for mobile professionals needing security, pen input, and all-day battery.

beard trimmer.name: Kemei
beard trimmer.description: The Kemei KM-2600 trimmer features stainless steel blades, a 0.25–9 mm trimming range, 120-minute battery life, and both corded and cordless use. Designed for beards and moustaches, it's ideal for men seeking reliable grooming at a budget price.

beard trimmer.name: BabylissPRO
beard trimmer.description: The BabylissPRO FXONE trimmer runs up to 3 hours on an interchangeable lithium battery and features a brushless motor, metal housing, and 7200 RPM deep-tooth T-blade. Built for barbers, it's perfect for high-precision styling and long-lasting performance.

beard trimmer.name: Gillette
beard trimmer.description: The Gillette Style Master is a cordless, waterproof trimmer with 4D blades and three combs for trimming in multiple directions. With a 45-minute battery life, pivoting head, and replaceable metal blade, it's great for flexible, close grooming.

beard trimmer.name: Bevel
beard trimmer.description: The Bevel Trimmer offers tool-free zero-gap adjustments, non-slip grip, and a blade designed to repel oil and dirt for less irritation. Its ergonomic build and thumb-turn blade dial make it a favorite for precise fades and daily use.

beard trimmer.name: Andis
beard trimmer.description: The Andis Master Cordless Clipper delivers over 90 minutes of runtime with carbon-steel blades adjustable from 000 to 1 and a powerful magnetic motor. Designed for professional precision and durability with a sleek aluminum body.

beard trimmer.name: Remington
beard trimmer.description: The Remington Crafter Beard Boss kit offers 180 minutes of cordless runtime, waterproof design, turbo mode, and multiple accessories for trimming goatees, mustaches, and more—ideal for detailed, long-lasting grooming control.

beard trimmer.name: Panasonic
beard trimmer.description: The Panasonic ER-SB40 trimmer uses a linear motor with 9,800 cuts per minute and 19 settings from 0.5–10 mm. With wide-tipped blades, ergonomic grip, and waterproof body, it's built for efficient trimming of thick, unruly hair.

beard trimmer.name: Wahl
beard trimmer.description: The Wahl Stainless Steel Lithium-Ion+™ trimmer offers a 3.5-hour runtime, quick charge, and 3 interchangeable heads for full grooming. With wet/dry use, 11 length settings, and a travel lock, it’s built for versatile, on-the-go styling.
